properties.description: Selecting an Activity board task takes too long to update the Node editor. Reproduce and measure the delay, then make selection feedback and loading responsive. The latest selection must win: obsolete requests must not block switching or replace the newly selected task. Avoid making ordinary selection wait unnecessarily for history or unrelated graph work. Preserve unsaved edits and stale-write protection. Verify rapid consecutive selections as well as the first selection after loading the board.
properties.title: Improve Node editor responsiveness when selecting Activity board tasks
